name: Wyvern Vortex
cardTexts: The Dragon steals a random treasure card from each player
erratas: Starting from the player involved in the encounter, roll a die to determine which card in the inventory is moved into the Dragon's hoard.

name: Molten Lair
cardTexts: Dragon's lowest value treasure is worth x3
erratas: Negative treasures are counted towards which treasure has the lowest value.

name: Poison Breath
cardTexts: Each player discards their highest value treasure card
erratas: In case of a tie, owner of treasure gets to decide which treasure is discarded.
- Mythical Monsters: Player with Chimera gets their second highest value treasure targeted instead

name: Quetzalcoetl Feather
cardTexts: Each player and the Dragon draws a treasure card
erratas: Starting from the player involved in the encounter, draw a card from the same treasure deck initially chosen in the encounter, go the next player in clockwise and the Dragon draws last.

name: Draconic Voodoo
cardTexts: Value is -100 per each item in inventory
erratas: Draconic Voodoo also affects the Dragon.

name: Naga Totem
cardTexts: +3 to roll value, -1 for each item in inventory
erratas: Naga Totem also affects the Dragon.

name: Hexed Drake Skull
cardTexts: All negative effects and treasures are now positive

name: Amphitere Idol
cardTexts: Double a Dragon card's effect and pass it to another player

name: Cunning Elixir
cardTexts: Add the danger level to your total roll value

name: Dragon Bone Dagger
cardTexts: Roll a die, add value to treasure's danger level
